title: Howard Stern Claps Back at Kim Kardashian's Paris Robbery Claim - NewsBreak
text:
By Evolve Editors ,
1 hours ago Photo Credit: BERTRAND GUAY/AFP via Getty Images Howard Stern recently responded to Kim Kardashian ’s claim that he mocked her Paris robbery incident. During an episode of “The Howard Stern Show,” the media personality spoke with his co-host Robin Quivers about the allegations Kardashian made against him. He pulled out old footage that showed the reality TV star accusing him of saying she faked the Paris robbery attempt. The broadcaster denied the allegations, saying he never thought it was fake.
Howard Stern responds to Kim Kardashian claiming he ‘mocked’ her Paris Robbery attack Howard Stern chose to fire back at Kim Kardashian ’s allegations that he mocked her Paris robbery attack. While speaking to his co-host Robin Quivers on “The Howard Stern Show,” he addressed how Kardashian, in a recent episode of The Kim Kardashian Show, accused him of claiming her Paris robbery was fake.
He then pulled out footage showing the SKIMS founder speaking about it.
“Howard Stern was like famously mocking it all the time and just saying that it was just I’m sick, and it’s such a joke, and I made it all up,” is what Kardashian is heard saying during the clip. She further mentioned how he was very “defiant” about it.
After pulling out the footage, Stern spoke about how, since the show is taped, he could go back and look up what he said, noting that “nothing could be further from the truth.”
The media personality continued saying that if she were “robbed at gunpoint by a bunch of dudes,” then it would be very “frightening.”
“If it is a farce, then really they should go to jail for that,” continued Stern, further adding that, according to him, the incident wasn’t fake.
Since the Kardashian-Jenners’ lives revolve around the camera, Stern joked that when an incident like this happens, there are no cameras in the area.
Stern joked that “one time the Kardashians don’t have a camera, something interesting happens.” He further said, “If anything, I would say, now tell me if I’m wrong, I would characterize that discussion as a very fair assessment that some people are saying it was fake, which was true.” He further explained that they didn’t think it was fake and truly believed that she had undergone something horrible.
Originally reported by Chhavi Puri on Reality Tea
